a4MicroSystemAiVision.batteryLevel: Returns the DFR1216 battery level in percent.
a4MicroSystemAiVision.setDualRgbColors: Sets the two onboard DFR1216 RGB LEDs at the same time, using predefined colors.
a4MicroSystemAiVision.setDualRgb: Sets the two onboard DFR1216 RGB LEDs at the same time, using RGB values from 0 to 255.
a4MicroSystemAiVision.setDualRgb|param|r: red value for RGB0, from 0 to 255
a4MicroSystemAiVision.setDualRgb|param|g: green value for RGB0, from 0 to 255
a4MicroSystemAiVision.setDualRgb|param|b: blue value for RGB0, from 0 to 255
a4MicroSystemAiVision.setDualRgb|param|r: red value for RGB1, from 0 to 255
a4MicroSystemAiVision.setDualRgb|param|g: green value for RGB1, from 0 to 255
a4MicroSystemAiVision.setDualRgb|param|b: blue value for RGB1, from 0 to 255
a4MicroSystemAiVision.setRgbBrightness: Sets the brightness used by the two onboard DFR1216 RGB LEDs.
a4MicroSystemAiVision.clearRgb: Turns off the two onboard DFR1216 RGB LEDs.
a4MicroSystemAiVision.initLcdUart: Initializes the DFRobot LCD display over UART at 9600 baud.
a4MicroSystemAiVision.initLcdUart|param|: controller TX pin connected to the display R pin
controller RX pin connected to the display T pin
